pull.title: fix(runtime): include the production Memories intent adapter
pull.body:
Ordinary DomainService publishing omitted the owner intent adapter, and catalog registration scanned only its declaration assembly. Include the adapter in the normal owner project graph and pass its actual factory assembly to SDK catalog registration.

Enroll DomainService.Tests in the Docker-free unit/contract inventory so the existing command/replay tests and the new production discovery regression execute in hosted CI. Preserve the original seven projects, trait exclusions, TRX and canonical coverage requirements. A controlled executable wrapper regression verifies all eight selections and their evidence options.

Release output consumes genuine public SDK 4.1.0 packages and the preparation dependency selects genuine Builds 4.44.4. Existing compatibility profiles and publication authorities remain intact.

Local validation: all 13 DomainService cases pass through ordinary Release/package MTP with real TRX and Cobertura; three existing CLI inventory/script/release controls pass. The production discovery case resolves the real adapter assembly and invokes its six SDK factories with matching declarations. Selected public archive signatures and output bodies were verified. Fresh hosted CI on the updated head and normal protected publication remain required.

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Changes the DomainService publish/runtime dependency closure and Event Store catalog registration for command/replay; regression and CI inventory tests reduce but do not replace hosted verification.
> 
> **Overview**
> **DomainService** now pulls in **`Hexalith.Memories.EventStoreExtensions`** on normal builds (project/package reference) and passes that assembly into **`AddEventStoreDevelopmentDomainCatalog`**, so the host’s runtime graph and dev catalog scan include the real **six-command intent adapter factory**, not just declaration metadata from EventStore.
> 
> A new **`ProductionCatalogAdapterTests`** regression resolves the adapter from the host’s dependency closure, invokes **`MemoriesCatalogAdapters.Create`**, and checks declarations, digests, and internal route contracts against **`MemoriesCatalogDeclarations`**.
> 
> **`Hexalith.Memories.DomainService.Tests`** joins the Docker-free unit/contract inventory (`test-projects.unit-contract.txt`, CI inventory guard, published-host profile edges). Coverage-gate fixtures now assert all **eight** projects run with the expected trait exclusions, TRX, and Cobertura options. Builds publication qualification **`buildsSha`** pins move to **`5fa2b97c8b22047c2c33e2c9f7017fd5d604c9ef`**.
> 
> <sup>Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit a4d1baac8c732563b362f9af1d92633945134662. Bugbot is set up for automated code reviews on this repo. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).</sup>
<!-- /CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
